item.title: A Prophetic Word for 2026 — Guaranteed Accurate
item.description: A biblical prophetic word for 2026 from Justin Peters, exposing false prophecy and calling believers to trust the sufficiency and unchanging truth of God’s Word.

item.title: Job 10 — Honest Lament Before God
item.description: Job 10 shows how biblical lament expresses faith as Job brings his suffering honestly before God and finds hope that ultimately points to Christ.

item.title: Why the Local Church Matters for Christian Growth and Perseverance
item.description: In this episode of Equipping You in Grace, Dave Jenkins explains why the local church is essential for Christian growth, perseverance, and faithfulness, and how God uses preaching, sacraments, shepherding, and community to sustain believers.

item.title: Men of Resolve, Learning to Pray with Strength and Dependence
item.description: Biblical manhood prayer teaches men to depend on God, not themselves. In this episode of Warriors of Grace, Dave Jenkins calls men to prayer as the posture of true strength and godly leadership in Christ.

item.title: Daily Repentance and the Christian Life
item.description: Why is daily repentance vital for the Christian life? Dave Jenkins explains how repentance restores fellowship with God, guards the heart, produces humility, and helps believers grow in grace.

item.title: Job 11: When Arrogant Counsel Misrepresents God
item.description: In Job 11, Zophar speaks with confidence but without compassion, misapplying truth and turning doctrine into condemnation. This episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave examines the danger of spiritual arrogance and calls believers to speak truth with humility and grace.

item.title: The Seven Mountain Mandate: A Biblical Examination
item.description: The Seven Mountain Mandate has become increasingly influential in certain Christian circles, shaping how some believers understand culture, authority, and the mission of the Church. In this episode of Contending for the Word, Dave Jenkins and Amy Spreeman examine the Seven Mountain Mandate carefully and biblically.
